name: WildFin Pan-Seared Pacific Halibut with Jasmine Rice
brandOrRestaurant: WildFin American Grill (Mountain View Village · Riverton, UT)
whyItWorks: Halibut is an ultra-lean, mild white fish with delicate flaky flesh that is effortless for an inflamed intestine to absorb. Paired with steamed jasmine rice, it is one of the safest high-end dinners in Riverton.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request halibut pan-seared with olive oil and salt only. Pair with plain steamed jasmine rice and skip asparagus spears or charred broccolini.
